candidate_ideas.statement: Hyperelliptic/Birman–Hilden classes generate St_6⊗Q as a Q[Mod_6]-module; equivalently, the Mod_6-orbit of im(b: St(Σ_{0,14})→St_6) generates St_6, or a Broaddus cyclic generator φ0 lies in that orbit up to units.
For S=(St_6)_{I_6}⊗Q, the odd summand vanishes: S^-=0, so that (S⊗H^{⊗5})_{Sp}=0.
Harer virtual duality over Q: H^{vcd}(Mod_6;V) ≅ (St_6 ⊗_Q V)_{Mod_6}.

H^{⊗5} is inflated from Sp_{12}(Z), so I_6 acts trivially and coinvariants stage as (S⊗H^{⊗5})_{Sp} with S=(St_6)_{I_6}⊗Q; central z=-1 acts as (-1)^5=-1 on H^{⊗5}, hence over Q one has (S⊗V)_{Sp}=(S^-⊗V)_{Sp}.

As mixed Hodge structures, H^{21}(M_{6,1};H^{⊗5}) ≅ H^{19}(M_6;H^{⊗5})(-1) via the universal closed curve (R^2=Q(-1), vcd killing E_2^{21,0} and E_2^{20,1}, differentials into/out of E^{19,2} vanishing).
Odd-tensor top vanishing H^{19}(M_6;H^{⊗5})=0, and the descended vanishings through the universal-curve identification and the five-stage Gr^W_{26} surjection.
Exact-corner vanishing: W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q)=0, equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21) is an empty direct sum of Q(8).
Dual boundary-restriction injectivity for the exact corner as a consequence of corner vanishing.

Residual CE geometry for (6,6): construct the evaluation-failure locus Z, stratify by h^0, determine components/stabilizers, prove Tate type of the codimension-13 contribution supported on Z, and assemble into the lowest-weight target.

established_facts.statement: R^1 π_* Q for the universal n-punctured curve is mixed of weights 1 and 2 (an extension of a rank n-1 Tate system of weight 2 by the rank 2g weight-1 system), never pure of weight 1. The correct weight floor is that H^p(base;L) has weight ≥ p+1.

The RED-0001 target W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}) is a pure polarizable Q-Hodge structure of weight -16; the entire weight-(2d-16) row is pure of that single weight, so polarizable pure Q-HS of fixed weight form a semisimple abelian category and there is no non-split-extension obstruction in this corner.
For RED-0001 residual pairs, the ordinary degree 2d-16 equals vcd for (6,6) (among others) and never exceeds vcd; vanishing above vcd does not kill the target degree 26=vcd(M_{6,6}).

For the forgetful map M_{6,6}→M_{6,5}, the q=0 term H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q) vanishes because 26>vcd(M_{6,5})=25; fibre cohomology lives only in q=0,1, so no Leray differential enters or leaves total degree 26.

After q=0 vanishing, the exact target is controlled by the mixed R^1 local system. Although the weight-two quotient has no Gr^W_{26} H^{25} contribution, the connecting map from Gr^W_{26} H^{24} of that quotient can alter the quotient of Gr^W_{26} H^{25} of the weight-one symplectic part; under the five-stage tower those connecting maps affect kernels only of the Gr^W_{26} surjections.
CGP/tropical/commutative-graph-complex controls top weight gr^W_{2d} H^*, whereas the target is lowest weight gr^W_{2d-16}; for (6,6) these are weight 42 versus weight 26 and never coincide.

For (g,n)=(6,6), the five-stage forgetful Leray-plus-residue argument with r=6-j produces a surjection Gr^W_{26} H^{21}(M_{6,1};H^{⊗5}) ↠ Gr^W_{26} H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q) (weight floor 27 kills residue quotients on Gr^W_{26}). This reduces exact-target vanishing to odd-tensor top-degree vanishing and does not by itself prove the corner.

The standard ordered 0-filling system of 2g arcs a1,b1,...,ag,bg represents the zero class in the Steinberg module St; Broaddus cyclicity uses a different nontrivial generator φ0. Treating the standard filling-system class as a cyclic generator of St does not compute (St ⊗ V)_G.

Any complete attack on the exact lowest-weight target for (g,n)=(6,6) must still confront residual CE geometry (balanced tetragonal splitting, W_5 failure locus Z, h^0 stratification, components/stabilizers) unless an independent vanishing of the exact corner is proved.

On any smooth genus-6 degree-four cover C→P^1 with balanced splitting F=O(4)⊕O(5), the f=4 CE obstruction vanishes identically, while the f=5 obstruction has degree 0 for any degree-six divisor Γ, so evaluation fails on Γ iff O_C(Γ) ≅ W_5 ⊗ ω_C^{-1}.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Dimension mismatch: the Steinberg module is the top reduced homology of the curve complex in degree 2g-2, while maximal simplices of the curve complex have dimension 3g-4=14 for g=6, not 2g-2.
invalid_steps.statement: Equating Steinberg top classes in degree 2g-2=10 with fundamental classes of maximal simplices of the curve complex.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Simplices of the curve complex require pairwise-disjoint curves; a Humphries generating set consists of intersecting curves and is not a simplex of C.
invalid_steps.statement: Treating intersecting Humphries chains of 2g+1 curves as simplices of the curve complex C, and using them as Steinberg generators.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Transitivity on a special set of intersecting chains does not move arbitrary filling systems into hyperelliptic/symmetric position and does not generate all of St_6⊗Q by the Mod-orbit of im(b: St(Σ_{0,14})→St_6).
invalid_steps.statement: Inferring that every filling carrier is Mod_6-equivalent to a hyperelliptic chain from Mod_6-transitivity on Humphries chains.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The central-sign argument only reduces Sp-coinvariants to the S^- summand; vanishing requires S^-=0, which needs a correct generation statement (or a Broaddus generator in that orbit), not mere +1 action on a symmetric subcomplex.
invalid_steps.statement: Concluding S^-=0 (hence (S⊗H^{⊗5})_{Sp}=0) from a fixed hyperelliptic involution acting as +id on a symmetric subcomplex C^{sym}, without a generation theorem for St_6 by hyperelliptic/Birman–Hilden classes.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: That class is zero in St; Broaddus cyclicity uses a different nontrivial generator φ0.
invalid_steps.statement: Using the standard ordered 0-filling class of 2g arcs as a cyclic generator of St fixed by handle half-turns to compute (St⊗V)_G.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Church–Farb–Putman kill only trivial-coefficient top cohomology, not odd symplectic coefficients.
invalid_steps.statement: Invoking Church–Farb–Putman top-cohomology vanishing to conclude H^{19}(M_6;H^{⊗5})=0 for odd symplectic local systems.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: Odd-tensor top vanishing H^{19}(M_6;H^{⊗5})=0, equivalently (S⊗H^{⊗5})_{Sp}=0 with S^-=0 for S=(St_6)_{I_6}⊗Q.
Exact corner W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) (equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21)) as a direct sum of Q(8); the five-stage Gr^W_{26} surjection alone does not settle it.
Nonvanishing of b: St(Σ_{0,14})→St_6 and generation of St_6 by its Mod_6-orbit (or placement of a Broaddus generator in that orbit).

Whether H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) is a direct sum of Q(-8).
